format: single European Wax Center franchised center (5-6 waxing suites, leased 1,000-1,600 sq ft)

invest.quote: The total investment necessary to begin operating a European Wax Center franchise is from $331,600.00 to $776,950.00. This includes $63,000.00 to $66,350.00 if you are a new franchisee, or $54,000.00 to $57,350.00 if you are an existing franchisee, that must be paid to us or our affiliates.

fee.quote: The standard Franchise Fee for new a franchisee is $45,000.00, and the standard Franchise Fee for an existing franchisee is $36,000.00.
fee.note: Existing franchisees pay $36,000. Franchisor may reduce or waive Franchise Fees case by case. Start-up Package of products ($18,000 to $21,000) must also be bought from the franchisor or its affiliate. Development Agreement (3+ centers): Development Fee $72,000 to $207,000.

royalty.quote: Royalty Fee 6.00% of Gross Sales. Weekly. You pay us. See definition of Gross Sales.

adFund.quote: Marketing Fund Contribution 3.00% of Gross Sales. Monthly. You pay our affiliate, EWC MFund, LLC, directly.
adFund.note: Since 2016 the local advertising obligation is combined into the single 3% marketing fund contribution. Grand opening advertising at least $12,000 (up to $35,000). Mandatory Local SEO/SEM program $275 per month.

otherRecurring.name: Imagery Auto-Shipment Program
otherRecurring.amount: Actual cost ... Ranges typically from $300.00 - $500.00 per month

otherRecurring.name: Other Auto-Shipment Programs
otherRecurring.amount: Actual costs of auto-shipped products ... Typically, it ranges from $300.00 - $2,500.00 per month

otherRecurring.name: National conference fees
otherRecurring.amount: Conference Fees: Up to $950.00 per person (conferences approximately every 18 months)

transferFee.amount: Transfer fee equal to 20.00% of the then-current Franchise Fee that would otherwise be payable by the transferee if purchasing a new franchise at such time (currently, $9,000.00 for new franchisees, $7,200.00 for existing franchisees). $1,000.00 processing fee paid in connection with each transfer request
